gdp.sql: SELECT "Country Name" AS country, "Country Code" AS country_code, "Country Code" IN ('AFE','AFW','ARB','CEB','CSS','EAP','EAR','EAS','ECA','ECS','EMU','EUU','FCS','HIC','HPC','IBD','IBT','IDA','IDB','IDX','INX','LAC','LCN','LDC','LIC','LMC','LMY','LTE','MEA','MIC','MNA','NAC','OED','OSS','PRE','PSS','PST','SAS','SSA','SSF','SST','TEA','TEC','TLA','TMN','TSA','TSS','UMC','WLD') AS is_aggregate, CAST("Year" AS INTEGER) AS year, "Value" AS gdp_usd FROM raw

population.sql: SELECT "Country Name" AS country, "Country Code" AS country_code, "Country Code" IN ('AFE','AFW','ARB','CEB','CSS','EAP','EAR','EAS','ECA','ECS','EMU','EUU','FCS','HIC','HPC','IBD','IBT','IDA','IDB','IDX','INX','LAC','LCN','LDC','LIC','LMC','LMY','LTE','MEA','MIC','MNA','NAC','OED','OSS','PRE','PSS','PST','SAS','SSA','SSF','SST','TEA','TEC','TLA','TMN','TSA','TSS','UMC','WLD') AS is_aggregate, CAST("Year" AS INTEGER) AS year, CAST("Value" AS BIGINT) AS population FROM raw

inflation.comment: DataHub's two inflation files are labelled the wrong way round: inflation-gdp holds consumer price inflation (US 2022: 8.0%, 2023: 4.1%) and inflation-consumer holds the GDP deflator (Norway 2023: -10.6%). Checked 7 Oct 2026.
inflation.sql: SELECT "Country" AS country, "Country Code" AS country_code, "Country Code" IN ('AFE','AFW','ARB','CEB','CSS','EAP','EAR','EAS','ECA','ECS','EMU','EUU','FCS','HIC','HPC','IBD','IBT','IDA','IDB','IDX','INX','LAC','LCN','LDC','LIC','LMC','LMY','LTE','MEA','MIC','MNA','NAC','OED','OSS','PRE','PSS','PST','SAS','SSA','SSF','SST','TEA','TEC','TLA','TMN','TSA','TSS','UMC','WLD') AS is_aggregate, CAST("Year" AS INTEGER) AS year, "Inflation" AS inflation_pct FROM raw

co2_monthly.sql: SELECT CAST(strptime(month, '%Y-%m') AS DATE) AS month, CASE WHEN average > 0 THEN average END AS co2_ppm, CASE WHEN deseasonalized > 0 THEN deseasonalized END AS co2_ppm_trend FROM raw

co2_annual.sql: SELECT CAST("Year" AS INTEGER) AS year, "Mean" AS co2_ppm FROM raw

co2_emissions.sql: SELECT CAST("Year" AS INTEGER) AS year, "Total" AS total_mt_carbon, "Gas Fuel" AS gas, "Liquid Fuel" AS liquid, "Solid Fuel" AS solid, "Cement" AS cement, "Gas Flaring" AS flaring, "Per Capita" AS per_capita_t_carbon FROM raw

temperature.sql: SELECT "Source" AS source, CAST("Year" AS INTEGER) AS year, "Mean" AS anomaly_c FROM raw

temperature_monthly.sql: SELECT "Source" AS source, CAST(strptime("Year", '%Y-%m') AS DATE) AS month, "Mean" AS anomaly_c FROM raw

sea_level.sql: SELECT CAST("Year" AS INTEGER) AS year, "CSIRO Adjusted Sea Level" AS csiro_inches, "NOAA Adjusted Sea Level" AS noaa_inches FROM raw

glaciers.sql: SELECT CAST("Year" AS INTEGER) AS year, "Mean cumulative mass balance" AS cumulative_mass_balance_mwe, "Number of observations" AS observations FROM raw

oil_prices.sql: SELECT 'Brent' AS benchmark, CAST("Date" AS DATE) AS month, "Price" AS usd_per_barrel FROM raw UNION ALL SELECT 'WTI', CAST("Date" AS DATE), "Price" FROM wti

gas_prices.sql: SELECT CAST("Date" AS DATE) AS month, "Price" AS usd_per_mmbtu FROM raw

gold_prices.sql: SELECT CAST("Date" AS DATE) AS month, "Price" AS usd_per_ounce FROM raw

sp500.sql: SELECT CAST("Date" AS DATE) AS month, nullif("SP500", 0) AS sp500, nullif("Dividend", 0) AS dividend, nullif("Earnings", 0) AS earnings, nullif("Real Price", 0) AS real_price, nullif("PE10", 0) AS pe10 FROM raw

us_house_prices.sql: SELECT CAST("Date" AS DATE) AS month, CASE area WHEN 'National-US' THEN 'US national' WHEN 'Composite-10' THEN '10-city composite' WHEN 'Composite-20' THEN '20-city composite' ELSE area END AS area, nullif(index, 0) AS index FROM (UNPIVOT raw ON COLUMNS(* EXCLUDE ("Date")) INTO NAME area VALUE index) WHERE index IS NOT NULL

us_bond_yield.sql: SELECT CAST("Date" AS DATE) AS month, "Rate" AS yield_pct FROM raw

exchange_rates.sql: SELECT CAST("Date" AS DATE) AS month, "Country" AS country, "Exchange rate" AS rate FROM raw

us_employment.sql: SELECT CAST(year AS INTEGER) AS year, population AS population_thousands, labor_force AS labor_force_thousands, employed_total AS employed_thousands, unemployed AS unemployed_thousands, unemployed_percent AS unemployment_rate_pct, employed_percent AS employment_population_ratio_pct FROM raw QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY population) = 1

vix.sql: SELECT CAST("Date" AS DATE) AS month, "Close" AS vix FROM raw
